text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. An essential preparation period
for the autumn Senior GⅠ races begins.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This year...! This year of all years...!
I must refrain from making hobby zines!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: We'll save the new King book for winter and go all out for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) this summer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh. So you won't let me read it, then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyoe?! King-san?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!
I definitely will at the winter event!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well. More importantly,
you're running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. King-san trained me as well,
so at long last, my showdown with Opera O-san
and Doto-san will—!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Then the Tenno Sho (Autumn) will be
a three-way battle—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, it looks like it'll be a battle between four.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Four of us? Was there another
Umamusume favored to win?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see...
Apparently, an unexpected challenger is running in the race."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? She's the girl who won
this year's NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh?! That number 4... is our junior?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you knew? Apparently that girl from the Classic class
is already making a move on Senior-class medium-distance races.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you don't trip up.
See ya."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Whaaat!? Friend or foe,
a fourth Umamusume has appeared~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
that girl, that girl is...!
choice_data_list: A formidable foe has appeared, huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You're right... But even more than that...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling so... fired up!
To think the day we'd run together would come so soon...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's so much I want to convey to her through racing!
Just like King-san taught me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want to convey the potential of Umamusume-chans
and the sheer splendor of the Twinkle Series.
I simply HAVE to share it...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Fwooo, something is awakening within me~. The... big sister trait inside of me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected challenger for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
The autumn season was suddenly getting intensely exciting.
